name: optimal
_comment: Optimal coherent-state CV-QKD operating point. Parameters follow the long-distance experimental regime of Huang et al., npj Quantum Information 2 (2016) 16025 and the coherent-state protocol of Grosshans & Grangier, PRL 88 (2002) 057902: near-optimal modulation variance V_A = alpha^2 = 4 SNU, detector efficiency eta = 0.6, electronic noise v_el = 0.015 SNU, channel excess noise xi = 0.01 SNU, reconciliation efficiency beta = 0.95, fibre loss 0.2 dB/km. saturation_level is set very high so the baseline detector never clips.
